newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji to export new sport-utility vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Fuji to export new sport-utility vehicles.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd will begin exporting its new Forester light sport-utility vehicle this summer to the United States and Europe, company president Takeshi Tanaka told a news conference on Thursday.
He said the Forester should account for 25 percent of Fuji Heavy"s projected 1997 overall overseas sales of 100,000 units.
Fuji Heavy, winning the world rally championship (WRC) with its Impreza model in 1995 and 1996, unveiled the new four-wheel-drive Forester model in Japan on Thursday.
The Forester was developed combining all technologies, including the four-wheel-drive system used in existing Impreza and its mainstay Legacy models, another Fuji official said.
"Exports of the new Forester in calendar 1997 will be a total 25,000 or 26,000 units, mainly to the United States, a Fuji executive vice president Kazuo Matsuzaki told Reuters.
The export of Foresters to the United States will be a monthly 4,000 or 5,000 in 1998 after some 2,000 a month in 1997, Matsuzaki said.
Fuji Heavy plans to sell 3,000 Foresters a month in Japan, Tanaka said.
